cards.back:
A very short unit of time, sixty in a minute.
Bahasa Indonesia: detik
Example: I counted ten seconds before he came back.
cards.say: second. A very short unit of time, sixty in a minute. I counted ten seconds before he came back.

cards.back:
A unit of time, sixty in an hour.
Bahasa Indonesia: menit
Example: The bus will come in five minutes.
cards.say: minute. A unit of time, sixty in an hour. The bus will come in five minutes.

cards.back:
A unit of time with sixty minutes.
Bahasa Indonesia: jam
Example: The film lasts two hours and ten minutes.
cards.say: hour. A unit of time with sixty minutes. The film lasts two hours and ten minutes.

cards.back:
A period of twenty-four hours.
Bahasa Indonesia: hari
Example: There are seven days in a week.
cards.say: day. A period of twenty-four hours. There are seven days in a week.

cards.back:
A period of seven days.
Bahasa Indonesia: minggu
Example: We have a spelling test every week.
cards.say: week. A period of seven days. We have a spelling test every week.

cards.back:
One of the twelve parts of a year.
Bahasa Indonesia: bulan
Example: We have a holiday next month.
cards.say: month. One of the twelve parts of a year. We have a holiday next month.

cards.back:
A period of twelve months.
Bahasa Indonesia: tahun
Example: There are twelve months in a year.
cards.say: year. A period of twelve months. There are twelve months in a year.

cards.back:
Saturday and Sunday.
Bahasa Indonesia: akhir pekan
Example: We visit Grandma at the weekend.
cards.say: weekend. Saturday and Sunday. We visit Grandma at the weekend.

cards.back:
The day before today.
Bahasa Indonesia: kemarin
Example: Yesterday we went to the zoo.
cards.say: yesterday. The day before today. Yesterday we went to the zoo.

cards.back:
This present day.
Bahasa Indonesia: hari ini
Example: Today is my best friend's birthday.
cards.say: today. This present day. Today is my best friend's birthday.

cards.back:
The day after today.
Bahasa Indonesia: besok
Example: We will take the test tomorrow.
cards.say: tomorrow. The day after today. We will take the test tomorrow.

cards.back:
The early part of the day.
Bahasa Indonesia: pagi
Example: I eat breakfast in the morning.
cards.say: morning. The early part of the day. I eat breakfast in the morning.

cards.back:
The time between lunch and evening.
Bahasa Indonesia: siang atau sore
Example: We play football in the afternoon.
cards.say: afternoon. The time between lunch and evening. We play football in the afternoon.

cards.back:
The time at the end of the day.
Bahasa Indonesia: sore atau malam
Example: We watch television in the evening.
cards.say: evening. The time at the end of the day. We watch television in the evening.

cards.back:
Twelve o'clock at night.
Bahasa Indonesia: tengah malam
Example: The clock struck midnight and I was asleep.
cards.say: midnight. Twelve o'clock at night. The clock struck midnight and I was asleep.

cards.back:
Twelve o'clock in the day.
Bahasa Indonesia: tengah hari
Example: We eat our lunch together at noon.
cards.say: noon. Twelve o'clock in the day. We eat our lunch together at noon.

cards.back:
A chart that shows the days and months of a year.
Bahasa Indonesia: kalender
Example: Mark the party on the calendar.
cards.say: calendar. A chart that shows the days and months of a year. Mark the party on the calendar.

cards.back:
The day each year that matches the date you were born.
Bahasa Indonesia: ulang tahun
Example: My birthday is at the end of March.
cards.say: birthday. The day each year that matches the date you were born. My birthday is at the end of March.

cards.back:
Before the usual or planned time.
Bahasa Indonesia: lebih awal, pagi-pagi
Example: I got up early to see the sunrise.
cards.say: early. Before the usual or planned time. I got up early to see the sunrise.

cards.back:
After the usual or planned time.
Bahasa Indonesia: terlambat
Example: Do not be late for school.
cards.say: late. After the usual or planned time. Do not be late for school.

cards.back:
Every time.
Bahasa Indonesia: selalu
Example: I always brush my teeth before bed.
cards.say: always. Every time. I always brush my teeth before bed.

cards.back:
Not at any time.
Bahasa Indonesia: tidak pernah
Example: My little brother never eats onions.
cards.say: never. Not at any time. My little brother never eats onions.

cards.back:
Not every time, but now and then.
Bahasa Indonesia: kadang-kadang
Example: Sometimes we walk to school together.
cards.say: sometimes. Not every time, but now and then. Sometimes we walk to school together.

cards.back:
Most of the time.
Bahasa Indonesia: biasanya
Example: I usually go to bed at eight.
cards.say: usually. Most of the time. I usually go to bed at eight.

cards.back:
Used to say the exact hour.
Bahasa Indonesia: pukul
Example: The lesson starts at nine o'clock.
cards.say: o'clock. Used to say the exact hour. The lesson starts at nine o'clock.
